ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Weë needs access to your camera so you can take photos and use them in your posts, your profile, WeeTalk and Weë AI.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Weë needs access to your microphone so you can record and send voice messages in WeeTalk.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Weë needs access to your photo library so you can choose photos and videos for your posts, your profile, WeeTalk and Weë AI.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Weë needs permission to save the images and videos you download from Weë AI to your photo library.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Weë uses your approximate location only while the app is open, to suggest nearby places and your area when you add a location to a post. Your exact location is never shown publicly.
